interpretation: No license was detected for the exact scJoint repository or its bundled checkpoint, so execution, adaptation, and redistribution remain blocked. Independent of terms, the official algorithm is transductive: it co-trains on target ATAC cells in stage 1, uses KNN pseudo-labels, and retrains in stage 3. Held donors cannot enter that workflow. scJoint outputs embeddings and label probabilities from expression or ATAC gene-activity matrices; it has no peak decoder and is ineligible for RNA-conditioned ATAC profile scoring.
remaining_blockers: Obtain written permission covering source execution, modification, local adaptation, checkpoint use, publication, and derivative redistribution before any package, code, or weight is executed.

Do not acquire or deserialize the bundled demonstration checkpoint. If permission is obtained, first freeze its source, terms, hash, configuration, corpus or demo dataset, and safe state-dict inspection record.
Implement and validate a frozen encoder/head query wrapper that excludes held rows from stage 1, KNN pseudo-labeling, stage 3, gene intersection, normalization, model selection, and calibration.
Freeze a GENCODE v49 gene order and a training-only, assay-valid ATAC gene-activity construction. Keep peak accessibility and gene activity distinct.
Prove GSE244832 aliquots remain separate populations, GSE296875 held donors never enter co-training, and GSE289173 is RNA-only inference after selection lock.

Validate the legacy PyTorch 1.0/1.4 implementation under a frozen compatible runtime on L40S, including numerical parity, eval mode, deterministic seeds, checkpoint resume, and memory, only after terms resolve.
Keep scJoint latent-only in the RNA-conditioned ATAC registry; no embedding, gene-activity matrix, class score, or KNN probability can satisfy the peak-profile contract.
